votes.plain_summary: The CRA board voted 5-0: approved TIF rebate for Golden Developments on Oak Avenue.

votes.item: 11. Consideration, Approval, and Authorization to Execute Resolution CRA20260901.1 adopting the Panama City Community Redevelopment Agency Fiscal Year 2026-2027 Annual Budget
votes.source_title: City of Panama City Community Redevelopment Agency Board Meeting of September 1, 2026 - Minutes
votes.plain_summary: The CRA board voted 5-0: adopted an $11.5 million CRA budget for FY2027.
votes.headline: Adopted an $11.5 million CRA budget for FY2027
votes.summary: Resolution CRA20260901.1 sets FY2026-27 spending of $5,074,482 for St. Andrews, $3,326,878 for Downtown, $1,863,545 for Downtown North and $1,228,009 for Millville, $11,492,914 in all (total added by researcher; https://www.panamacity.gov/AgendaCenter/ViewFile/Item/17481?fileID=37375). The attached budget table shows Millville at $1,288,009, so the resolution and the table differ by $60,000.

votes.item: 12. Consideration and Approval of the Small-Business Property Activation & Redevelopment Kickstart (SPARK) Pilot Program in Downtown North CRA District
votes.source_title: City of Panama City Community Redevelopment Agency Board Meeting of September 1, 2026 - Minutes

votes.headline: Created the SPARK small-business pilot program in Downtown North
votes.summary: The board approved the SPARK pilot program, with revisions, for the Downtown North district. A board member asked for scoring, a clear definition of affordable housing, and phases.

votes.item: 15. Discuss the CRA's involvement with the FLOCK program with PCPD - motion to eliminate the CRA funding from the FLOCK camera program
votes.source_title: City of Panama City Community Redevelopment Agency Board Meeting of September 1, 2026 - Minutes
votes.plain_summary: The CRA board voted 5-0: ended CRA funding for the police FLOCK camera program.
votes.headline: Ended CRA funding for the police FLOCK camera program
votes.summary: The CRA had helped pay for the Panama City Police Department's FLOCK license-plate camera program for five years. The board voted to stop that funding.

votes.item: approve the Mobile Home Skirting Grant
votes.source_title: City of Callaway CRA Budget Hearing - Minutes, October 28, 2025
votes.plain_summary: The Callaway CRA board voted 5-0 (all present) to approve the Mobile Home Skirting Improvement Grant.
votes.headline: Created a mobile home skirting grant
votes.summary: A CRA grant that pays part of the cost of skirting for mobile homes. The city manager said applicants may have no code violations other than skirting. The minutes give no dollar amount.
